methodology.full: Two sequential full gzip-file-to-StreamParser runs per format in a fresh child process; data event counts discard quads; times include cached-file reading and decompression.
methodology.sample: First 870 complete messages (100050 triples), copied as exact delimited frame bytes; each case in a fresh child process, 2 warmups, 5 timed samples, forced GC before timing; references and buffers prepared outside timing.
methodology.validation: Every sample statement/term and message boundary compared with the legacy source outside timing; every writer sample round-tripped with ordered term equality; full runs checked row and message counts.
methodology.memory: RSS high-water from process.resourceUsage; whole process includes imports, warmup and, for sample cases, references/validation. No claim of exclusive per-operation allocation.
methodology.legacy: RiverBench legacy input is protocol tag 1 (Jelly 1.0). Writer cases marked 1.1 emit tag 2. Local input filename v1.1 is only a historical filename.
methodology.prototype: fastfit cases monkey-patch ColumnEncoder.fit only inside benchmark workers; library source unchanged.
methodology.limits: One regular dataset with a named-node/literal-only prefix sample, one prefix sample, sequential case order, local CPU/OS/cache conditions, only two full repetitions. SPARQL cases synthesize 3-variable SELECT bindings from the sample, not a downloaded SPARQL workload.
